newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London creep cautiously higher.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London creep cautiously higher.

text.p: Japanese shares in London crept higher on Tuesday buoyed by banking stocks, but displaying little enthusiasm as players remained cautious after recent gains, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 climbed 27.90 points to close at 1,441.65.
In Tokyo, shares galloped higher to close 467.95 points up at 21,310.59, spurred on by Wall Street gains overnight.

"The market looks quite toppy here and tomorrow we may see some profit taking," said one trader. "Most issues in London are well offered but weakness in New York is dragging down the Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago."
In early London trading, dealers said profit taking pulled many shares lower after recent gains, but strength in the banking sector held the index in positive territory.
"A large percentage of business has been in Sanwa bank which is going into the Nikkei 225 at the expense of Honshu Paper which is merging with New Oji Paper," said one trader.
Sanwa climbed 100 yen to close at 2045 yen in London.
